# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.5 Worker 1: Persia and Central Asia (oe_per_, Slot 90, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v115_persia.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 90 entry: scheduler host scope, once a quarter. Only world-level state lives here; the countries
# of the theatre are checked by their own quarterly pulse (on_action/oe_per_pulse.txt).
oe_per_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_per_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_per_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_per_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_per_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_per_pulse_count add = 1 }
}

# Country scope: a protagonist's quarterly check.
oe_per_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_per_renaissance_score
			var:oe_per_renaissance_score >= 60
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ren_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ren_cd years = 20 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_per_timurid_renaissance_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_axis_cd }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam <= -30
				oe_per_has_qizilbash_levies = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_per_axis_cd years = 15 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_per_qizilbash_banner_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam >= 30 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_per_axis_cd years = 15 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_per_ghulam_corps_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_per_full_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	oe_per_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one story event whose condition holds.
oe_per_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev1_done }
			current_year <= 1380
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1370
			OR = {
				owns = location:samarkand
				owns = location:herat
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev3_done }
			has_advance = oe_per_adv_zij_sultani
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev5_done }
			current_year >= 1450
			OR = {
				AND = {
					exists = religion
					religion = religion:shia
				}
				oe_per_has_qizilbash_levies = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev6_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			has_advance = pike_and_shot_advance
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev9_done }
			current_year >= 1590
			owns = location:isfahan
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev9_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev10_done }
			current_year >= 1600
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:shia
			has_variable = oe_per_renaissance_score
			var:oe_per_renaissance_score >= 40
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev10_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev12_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev12_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev13_done }
			owns = location:samarra
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev13_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev14_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			owns = location:kabul
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev14_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev4_done }
			is_ai = yes
			has_variable = oe_per_renaissance_score
			var:oe_per_renaissance_score >= 30
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev7_done }
			is_ai = yes
			has_advance = oe_per_adv_ghulam_standing_corps
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev8_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1598
			owns = location:isfahan
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_ev11_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1622
			has_ports = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_ev11_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.11
	}
}

# Country scope. Cultural flowering, 0..100. v = amount.
oe_per_add_renaissance = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_renaissance_score } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_renaissance_score value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_per_renaissance_score add = $v$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_per_renaissance_score min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Army axis, -100 (tribal Qizilbash banners) .. 100 (ghulam standing corps). v = amount.
oe_per_shift_army_axis = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam add = $v$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_per_qizilbash_vs_ghulam min = -100 max = 100 }
}

# Dev panel: push both state values so the thresholds can be seen at once.
oe_per_dev_boost = {
	oe_per_add_renaissance = { v = 60 }
	oe_per_shift_army_axis = { v = 40 }
}

# Dev panel: research this theatre's advances.
oe_per_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_per_adv_zij_sultani } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_per_adv_zij_sultani
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_per_adv_chaldiran_gunpowder } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_per_adv_chaldiran_gunpowder
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_per_adv_ghulam_standing_corps } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_per_adv_ghulam_standing_corps
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_per_adv_isfahan_silk_factories } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_per_adv_isfahan_silk_factories
	}
}

# Dev panel: run the slot entry and this country's quarterly check now.
oe_per_dev_force_tick = {
	oe_per_monthly = yes
	oe_per_country_tick = yes
}

# Dev panel: readout.
oe_per_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_per.90
}
